tool_input.command:
$form = 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}'
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body $form -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$auth = $login.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
$token = [string]$auth.accessToken
$configUri = 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/cs/configs?dataId=shared-druid-dev.yml&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&tenant=zscloud&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token)
$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $configUri -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$content = [string]$response.Content
'CONFIG_HTTP=' + [int]$response.StatusCode
'CONFIG_LENGTH=' + $content.Length
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($content)) { 'CONFIG_EMPTY=true' } else {
  $keys = [regex]::Matches($content, '(?m)^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+):') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Select-Object -Unique
  'TOP_LEVEL_KEYS=' + ($keys -join ',')
  'HAS_SPRING_DATASOURCE=' + [bool]([regex]::IsMatch($content, '(?i)spring\s*:\s*\r?\n\s+datasource'))
  'HAS_JDBC_URL=' + [bool]([regex]::IsMatch($content, '(?i)jdbc:'))
  'HAS_PASSWORD_KEY=' + [bool]([regex]::IsMatch($content, '(?im)^\s*password\s*:'))
  'HAS_USER_KEY=' + [bool]([regex]::IsMatch($content, '(?im)^\s*username\s*:'))
}
